title: Keto Australian Beef Skewers
description: Grilled Australian beef skewers marinated in a rich and tangy sauce, perfect for a keto compliant meal.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
3. Add the beef strips to the marinade and toss to coat.
4. Thread the marinated beef onto skewers.
5. Brush the coconut oil onto the grill or grill pan.
6. Grill the beef skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
7. While the beef is cooking, mix together Greek yogurt and a pinch of salt for the yogurt sauce.
8. Serve the grilled beef skewers with the yogurt sauce, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
